options.name: Innate Caster
options.description: You are a natural conduit for magic, channeling spells through sheer will rather than study. Gain 2 sorcerer spell slots, but lose 2 spell capacity. Sorcerer spells can be swapped at a full rest for any spell you could potentially learn, but they cannot be charged.

options.name: Studied Sorcerer
options.description: You have supplemented your natural talent with academic study. Gain +1 skill with magic knowledge and +2 spell capacity.

options.name: Gifted Sorcerer
options.description: Your innate magical presence is undeniable. Gain +2 sorcerer spell slots, but lose 2 spell capacity. Gain +1 skill with presence.

options.name: Magical Resilience
options.description: Your natural connection to magic grants you an innate resistance to magical forces. Gain +2 aetheric mitigation, +2 dark mitigation and +2 divine mitigation.

options.name: Reaction : Reactive Spell
options.description: In response to a creature taking an action within a very short (5 unit) distance of you, you can channel one of your sorcerer spells.

options.name: Action : Sorcerous Surge
options.description: When you channel a sorcerer spell, you can surge it with innate power. The spell's range is doubled, its area of effect is increased by 1 unit, and allies within the area are unaffected.

options.name: Sorcerous Mastery
options.description: Your innate magic has reached a new threshold. Gain +3 sorcerer spell slots. Your sorcerer spells no longer fizzle on a failed spell check and do not require incantations to channel them.

options.name: Arcane Affinity
options.description: Your natural talent extends into the arcane. Gain +1 skill with arcane magic and +1 maximum energy.

options.name: Primal Affinity
options.description: Your natural talent extends into primal and metamagic forces. Gain +1 skill with primal magic and +1 skill with meta magic.

options.name: Action : Force Charge
options.description: You force a charge on one of your sorcerer spells without requiring a component. The spell is removed from your sorcerer spell list after use. If you successfully channel the spell, you cannot use that spell as a sorcerer spell for 1d10 full rests. If you fail to channel the spell, you can never use it as a sorcerer spell again.
